name: Gap DM
summary: This EA detects price gaps at market open or between candles and trades on the expectation that gaps will be filled or continue in the gap direction. It systematically identifies gap conditions, enters positions based on gap size and direction, and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA检测市场开盘或K线之间的价格跳空，并基于跳空回补或延续跳空方向的预期进行交易。它系统性地识别跳空条件，根据跳空大小和方向入场，并通过可配置的止损和止盈管理交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于价格跳空(Gap)的突破交易，当检测到当前开盘价与前一周期收盘价之间存在显著跳空时触发交易信号。入场条件是跳空幅度超过设定的最小阈值，向上跳空做多，向下跳空做空。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损水平，以及跳空回补后的平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和每日最大亏损控制等参数。策略假设大部分跳空会在短期内回补，因此倾向于在跳空方向的对立面入场或顺势追击跳空方向。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on price gap breakout trading, triggering trade signals when a significant gap is detected between the current open price and the previous period's close price. Entry conditions require the gap size to exceed a configurable minimum threshold, going long on upside gaps and short on downside gaps depending on the strategy mode. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels, as well as a gap-fill closure logic that closes positions when the price returns to fill the gap. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management provides parameters for maximum open positions and daily loss limits to control overall exposure. The strategy operates on the assumption that most gaps will be filled in the short term, making it a systematic gap-trading approach that can trade either in the direction of the gap or against it for gap-fill plays.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码，用于区分订单

parameters.name: GapMode
parameters.description: 跳空交易模式：1=跳空回补，2=跳空追随

parameters.name: TimeFilter
parameters.description: 是否启用交易时段过滤

pros: 跳空交易逻辑清晰，基于统计上有优势的市场现象
提供了跳空回补和跳空追随两种模式，策略灵活性较好
包含最大持仓数和时段过滤等风险控制参数
跳空大小阈值可配置，避免在微小跳空中频繁交易
策略概念容易理解和验证，适合进一步优化
pros_en: Gap trading logic is clear and based on statistically validated market phenomena
Provides both gap-fill and gap-continuation modes for strategic flexibility
Includes risk control parameters such as maximum positions and time filters
Configurable gap size thresholds prevent over-trading on minor gaps
Strategy concept is easy to understand and validate, suitable for further optimization
cons: 跳空策略在低流动性市场中可能产生虚假信号
缺少跳空大小与止损止盈之间的动态关联机制
未考虑跳空发生时的市场整体趋势环境
固定点数止损止盈在不同波动率环境下适应性差
缺少对新柱检测的严格判断，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
cons_en: Gap strategy may generate false signals in low-liquidity markets
Lacks dynamic correlation between gap size and stop loss/take profit levels
Does not consider the overall market trend context when gaps occur
Fixed pip-based SL/TP lacks adaptability across different volatility environments
Missing strict new bar detection may lead to repeated entries within the same candle
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整出场水平
添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），避免逆趋势跳空交易
实现跳空大小与仓位比例的动态映射，大跳空适当放大仓位
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic SL/TP to automatically adjust exit levels based on market volatility
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid trading against the trend on gaps
Implement dynamic position sizing mapped to gap size, scaling up on larger gaps with proper risk limits

risk_points: 跳空交易在重大新闻事件后可能遭遇持续单边行情导致止损被扩大滑点
固定止损在极端波动行情下可能不足以覆盖风险
缺少对账户整体风险的实时监控和强制平仓机制
risk_points_en: Gap trading may face extended slippage on stop losses during post-news sustained directional moves
Fixed stop loss may be insufficient to cover risk in extreme volatility conditions
Lacks real-time account-level risk monitoring and forced liquidation mechanism
